parameters.content:
## 04 LinkedIn Inbound Triage

Classifies inbound LinkedIn contacts into lead, recruiter, spam or peer and routes each accordingly.

**Safety rails:** Calls 16-safety-rails before any outbound action.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

nodes.name: Every Morning 08:00
nodes.notes: LinkedIn has no general inbound-message API. This reads an export you drop somewhere the instance can fetch - see docs/SETUP.md.

nodes.name: Safety Rails
nodes.notes: Calls 16-safety-rails. Nothing that can reach a prospect runs before the rails return allowed=true.

nodes.name: Rails Allowed?
nodes.notes: False branch is a dead end by design.

nodes.name: CRM Upsert
nodes.notes: One HTTP node, one mapping node. Swap CRM by changing CRM_BASE_URL, the credential and CRM_ADAPTER. See docs/CRM-MAPPING.md.

=INSERT INTO suppression_list (identifier, identifier_type, reason, source, created_at)
VALUES (lower(nullif('{{ $json.lead.handle }}', '')), 'handle', 'linkedin_spam',
        '04-linkedin-inbound-triage', NOW())
ON CONFLICT (identifier, identifier_type) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Add To Suppression
nodes.notes: Spam goes on the suppression list so no other workflow in the pack ever contacts it.
